nameJa: モノスペースのリズム
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: YouTubeとLive Chatを等幅文字、Fullscreenを通常幅のサンセリフで組み合わせる。小さな赤い四隅と動画図を添えた合理的なポスター。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE rational, typographically refined graphic poster for a Chrome extension store listing. Canvas MUST be a compact landscape11:7 rectangle, exactly1760x1120, not a panoramic banner. Typography is primary; diagram is small and secondary.

Font design is the crucial requirement. Deliberately pair TWO distinctly different type styles:
1. YouTube in a modern MONOSPACED face, MEDIUM weight, large and clearly readable, about70px cap height at1572px image width.
2. Fullscreen in an elegant normal-width REGULAR GROTESK, around95px cap-height, with open air between forms, NOT heavy or condensed.
3. Live Chat in the SAME readable MEDIUM MONOSPACED face as YouTube, around80px cap-height, giving a deliberate rational rhythm.
This pairing must be unmistakable. The monospace letters have equal advance widths and a refined engineered feel, but NO terminal/hacker/coding clichés, no extra brackets in text, no blinking cursor. Avoid rounded cartoon, ultra-bold Arial, black weights, extreme condensed type or oversized block lettering. No letter extrusion, bevel, embossed material, paper/plastic, shadows, glow or dimensional effects.

Palette: clean warm-ivory field, almost-black flat letterforms, precisely placed tiny red modular registration-like framing accents. Calm editorial sophistication, impeccable optical alignment and confident breathing room.
Composition: YouTube sits upper-left on its own horizontal line. Fullscreen has a generous dominant line through the middle-left; Live Chat is placed on the next baseline slightly offset right, not a large all-left word stack. A small black-outline16:9 video diagram sits lower-right or lower-center, without touching any words. Four tiny red outer corner marks signal fullscreen. Inside the SAME screen place a small black play triangle and one RED outline chat pane inset from ALL four video boundaries, showing only three short strokes. Entire chat must remain INSIDE the complete fullscreen boundary. Fine crisp strokes, anonymous abstract symbols only.

Exactly these THREE text elements once each: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". No other visible word, label, number, watermark, official logo or slogan. Fullscreen one word. YouTube capitalY/capitalT. Comfortable reading at220x140, every letter at least8 percent away from all canvas edges. Do not crop letters or canvas content. No humans, games, scenery, photos, dashboards or realistic browser chrome.
